entries.note: A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Preparing and explains as a parcel handed to the warehouse or handled there. It may come before any scan, so it says no more than registered; a scan staged accepted refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels In Transit and explains as anything from the handover to a carrier to customs and transport in the destination country, so a staged scan refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Undelivered and explains as a delivery attempt that failed.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Delivered.

entries.wording: Order information received. We're expecting your parcel to arrive with us.
entries.note: An order scan before Shouwu has the parcel.
The last mile's manifest record of a parcel, under Shouwu's order scans, before its courier has it.
An order scan, the first a parcel gets, before Shouwu has it.
A label made for the parcel, without a place, a day after the order data and before the first scan at a pickup point.

Written on schedule two hours after the order data, days before the first facility scan: no one has the parcel yet, though the page's status turns In Transit with it. The parser reads one written a day or more after the order data as the acceptance.
Shouwu's warehouse taking the parcel in, which the page's Preparing status covers.
The warehouse done with the parcel before its flight, which the page's Preparing status still covers.

entries.wording: The ship has already set sail
entries.note: Shouwu's ship leaving China on a sea line, after the export clearance and before the arrival at the port abroad.

entries.wording: Shipment started the customs clearance process at destination

entries.note: Released by customs in the destination country.
A handover to the destination's delivery carrier, not to the recipient.
A sorting centre on the way, seen in the destination country the day after the handover to the local courier.
The same sorting centre in the destination country let the parcel go, hours after its arrival there.

entries.wording: First parcel scan along Poste Italiane’s logistic network

entries.wording: In transit along Poste Italiane’s logistic network

entries.note: The local courier's delivery round.
The local courier's delivery, after its round, with no place.
The local post's delivery to the recipient.
The last-mile carrier's delivery to the recipient.
The first scan in the hands of the forwarder that takes the parcel to the flight, after the order data.
Shouwu's partner collecting the parcel from the seller, the first scan after the order data.
The partner's sort in China after its collection. Its pattern covers any facility's town.
The partner's departure from its sort facility in China. Its pattern covers any facility's town.
The last mile's transit hub, as its wording spells it.
The last mile's destination hub, as its wording spells it.
China's export declaration done before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
China's export release before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
Customs in the destination released the import after "Under Clearance"; the parcel is no longer held.
The flight landed, a day after it left China; the tracker places it at "EU".

entries.wording: The shipment has reached the destination station
entries.note: The destination's station after the flight landed and before customs started on the parcel.
Released by customs in the destination country.
The flight leaving with the parcel, after it went to the airline and before its arrival in the destination country.
On the way to the airline, written with the export declaration and before the flight.

entries.wording: The goods have been sent to the next station
entries.note: The facility sending the parcel on, after the forwarder's first scan.

entries.wording: The shipment is in domestic transit
entries.note: The parcel on its way across China to the export port, between the forwarder's first scans and the export release.

entries.wording: The shipment could not be delivered, and the recipient has been notified.
entries.note: DHL's failed delivery on the line into Germany: the recipient got a card, and the parcel goes on to an outlet.

entries.wording: The shipment is being brought to [Postfiliale].The earliest time when it can be picked up can be found on the notification card.
entries.note: DHL's parcel on its way to the outlet that keeps it after the failed delivery, as DHL's "Available for pickup shortly" is: the card says when it can be picked up, so it is not there yet. Its pattern covers any outlet in the brackets.

entries.wording: The shipment is waiting for transit
entries.note: Waiting at a facility for its next leg, before the flight and again after it.
A facility's scan in China after the forwarder took the parcel in.
Packed in China for the flight, before the leaving scan.
Leaving the facility in China before the export declaration.
The same hand-over closed with a full stop, on a line whose next row is the arrival at the destination airport.
The flight's arrival abroad, the day after the hand-over to the airline; customs has not started on the parcel.
The destination's customs releasing the parcel, after its clearance there and before the overseas processing centre.
The destination country's processing centre, hours after customs released the parcel.
The last mile's departure from that centre, on to its transit facility.
The last mile's transit facility, before its local one.
The last mile's local facility, the day after its transit facility and an hour before the round.

entries.wording: Shipment is in transit to next facility

entries.note: Two hours after the pickup: the parcel reaching the facility it leaves China from.
Hours after the arrival at the origin facility: the parcel leaving it.
The newest row on a parcel the page still showed as In Transit (TRACE_STATUS_ON_THE_WAY), the day after a facility departure: it names no delivery.
The local courier's round that did not deliver, after its out-for-delivery scan; the reason follows as its own scan.
The local courier's reason for a failed round, in angle brackets; the parcel went on in transit after it.
iMile's driver's reason for a failed round in Italy, in angle brackets, after its out-for-delivery row.
iMile, the delivering partner in Italy, receiving the parcel at its centre. iMile's sentences read its rows whatever centre they name.
iMile sending the parcel on to its delivery station.
Back at iMile's delivery station after the round failed, as iMile's map reads it.
After two failed rounds, the delivery station sends the parcel back to iMile's centre.
iMile closing the delivery order without a delivery, as on its own return rows.

entries.wording: FR, Votre envoi est en transit sur nos plateformes logistiques.,运输途中
entries.note: The French delivering partner's transit row, after the sort in the Netherlands, with the country before it and Shouwu's Chinese for in transit after it.

entries.wording: Germany, Die Sendung wurde im Briefzentrum bearbeitet.,运输途中
entries.note: The German delivering partner's sort at a letter centre, with the country before it and Shouwu's Chinese for in transit after it.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at a carrier facility
entries.note: After the handover to the carrier that flies the parcel. The first one right after the registration, without a receipt that moved the parcel, is the acceptance.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at an air hub
Shipment started the customs clearance process at origin
entries.note: Export clearance in China, a routine step before the flight, not a hold.

entries.wording: Shipment departed from a carrier facility
Shipment completed the customs clearance process at destination

entries.wording: Shipment arrived in the destination country
Shipment has been sorted at the carrier facility
entries.note: A sort in the destination country after customs released the parcel.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been prepared by your web merchant. It will soon be delivered to Colis Privé.
entries.note: Colis Privé's notice of the parcel's data, relayed before Shouwu's own scans; nothing has moved.

entries.wording: Your parcel arrived at the shipping partner. It will be sent to Colis Privé.
entries.note: Colis Privé's record of the parcel reaching the partner that brings it to France, relayed. That partner is Shouwu's line, and the row comes before the parcel leaves Shouwu's warehouse, beside its intake.

entries.wording: Your package is in transit to Colis Privé
entries.note: Relayed from Colis Privé before it has the parcel. The row comes before the parcel leaves Shouwu's warehouse, beside its intake and processing: the line has the parcel, which has not moved.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: DHL's first scan in Germany, relayed after the sort that follows customs at the destination.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the destination parcel center
entries.note: DHL's sort at the parcel centre that serves the recipient, relayed before its round.
Relayed a second before DHL's processing at the destination parcel centre, on the same leg.
DHL's round in Germany, after the destination parcel centre: no such recipient at the address, and the return follows.
DHL's round in Germany, a second after "The recipient is unknown": the address did not serve, and the return to origin follows.

entries.wording: Shipment will be returned to origin-Bad address
entries.note: DHL sending the parcel back after the round could not find the address: on its way back, not yet with the sender, as the Italian last mile's "Back to Sender" is.

entries.wording: Shipment sent directly from parcel center to business customer
entries.note: DHL's delivery from the parcel centre to a business recipient, "ab Paketzentrum dem Geschäftskunden zugestellt" in German. After DHL sent the parcel back, it is the return delivered to the sender: the parser reads it as returned.
The delivering partner in Germany sent the parcel to the wrong facility and sends it on: a delay, not a stop. The round came the same day.
The delivering partner's round in Germany.
Unloaded from a line haul's vehicle or a round's at the destination's depot in Germany, hours after the destination parcel centre and before the round's loading.
Loaded onto a line haul's vehicle or a delivery round's, which it does not tell apart; seen after the out-for-delivery scan.

entries.wording: The shipment has been successfully delivered
entries.note: The delivering partner's delivery in Germany.
A hub on the way to the delivering carrier, after customs released the parcel at the gateway airport.
The delivering carrier's local branch, after the hub: the parcel waits there for its round, not for collection.
The delivering carrier's courier took the parcel at the branch, before its round.
The delivering carrier's round.
Arrived at the receiving point: the forwarder's receiving point has the parcel.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The goods' electronic data received, beside the order's own data row.
A partner's data row; one dated after the parcel moved reads as in transit.
A batch, named by its code, declared for the road to Hong Kong. Its pattern covers any batch code.
Arrived at the port of departure, waiting for a flight.
The parcel at a port on its way, in English without the port's name.
The flight booked for a day of the month, here the 23rd, before it flies: a forecast, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it. Its pattern covers any day and the second leg's (二程) row.
The flight left.
The flight landed.
The second leg's flight left.
Landed; the parcel is being cleared and collected from the airline.
Import clearance done.
Handed to the delivering partner's depot and scanned there.

FedEx collecting the parcel from Shouwu's depot in the United States after the import clearance, its town and postcode before the wording. Shouwu had the parcel long before, so it is no handover from the sender.
FedEx's scans after it collected the parcel from Shouwu's depot, copied in FedEx's words.
FedEx's scans after it collected the parcel from Shouwu's depot, copied in FedEx's words.

entries.wording: Your consignment has been picked up
entries.note: The delivering partner collecting the parcel from Shouwu's depot abroad, after the clearance. Shouwu had the parcel long before, so it is no handover from the sender.
The delivering partner's delivery in the Netherlands, after its out-for-delivery rows.

entries.wording: The goods have been deliverey to the final delivery service provider
entries.note: The hand-over to the last-mile partner after import clearance; "deliverey" is Shouwu's spelling.
The destination agent's receipt of the flight's notice of arrival, after the landing and before clearance.
Import clearance under way, before "Customs clearance has been completed".
Colis Privé's delivery to the recipient's letterbox, on the line into France.
A delivering partner's sort centre after the import clearance. Shouwu's own warehouse intake is "Arrival processing center".
The parcel leaving a delivering partner's sort centre after the import clearance.

entries.note: A delivering partner's failed attempt; another delivery run follows. The link the wording points to is not relayed.
The order's data, written a second before "Shipment information received".
The delivering partner's data row, beside its "Shipment Announced", with Shouwu's 其他 (other) before it. Dated after the parcel moved, it reads as in transit.

entries.wording: The warehouse is currently processing the goods.
entries.note: The flying carrier's warehouse handling the parcel, days after it arrived there.

entries.wording: The shipment begins at the point of origin.
entries.note: Leaving the warehouse at the origin, seconds after its processing.
The flight booked, before the export clearance: a forecast, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 因中港查验延误，需安排新航班。
entries.note: An inspection on the road to Hong Kong delayed the parcel, so a new flight is booked: it waits for that flight, not on a problem.
China's export clearance, a day before the flight; the parcel is not held in customs.
Import clearance at the destination, after the flight arrived.
The first scan after the order data, before the sorting center's inbound: the forwarder's warehouse taking the parcel in.

entries.wording: Item is in transit in Hong Kong
Item is in transit in European

entries.wording: Item has started customs clearance process

The local courier's transit row, after the import clearance.

entries.wording: Currently undergoing customs clearance in the destination country

entries.wording: Failed delivery for reason: recipient was not at home

The destination's import clearance under way, a day after the flight's arrival.
The import clearance again, hours after the row that it is under way, without saying it is done; the next row schedules the delivery.
Shouwu's row after the import clearance, days before the delivering partner's depot and round: a delivery planned, not under way.
DPD's transit scan, as its German app words it, on the line DPD delivers.
DPD's delivering depot, before the round and again after a failed one.
DPD's delivery round.
The delivering partner's arrival in a town after the import release, under the town's name.
The delivering partner leaving a town on its way, between its arrivals.

17TRACK's sub-status name, which Shouwu gives as the scan's wording on a line it reads from 17TRACK: it means what 17TRACK's sub-status means. The pickup, after the order's registration.
17TRACK's sub-status name, which Shouwu gives as the scan's wording on a line it reads from 17TRACK: it means what 17TRACK's sub-status means.

17TRACK's sub-status name, which Shouwu gives as the scan's wording on a line it reads from 17TRACK: it means what 17TRACK's sub-status means.
17TRACK's sub-status name, which Shouwu gives as the scan's wording on a line it reads from 17TRACK: it means what 17TRACK's sub-status means. Released from customs, the parcel moves on.
Held for the destination's import clearance.
Released by the destination's customs; the parcel moves on.

entries.wording: Arrived in transit country/region Arrive attransit country or district.

A line's milestone title, which Shouwu repeats as its description on the line into Europe and the adapter reads once: a movement between facilities.

entries.wording: Leaving transit country/region Parcel outbound from transit facility

entries.note: A line's milestone title followed by its description, as Shouwu relays them on the line into Europe: departure from a transit country.
A line's milestone title, which Shouwu repeats as its description on the line into Europe and the adapter reads once: the delivering carrier's receipt, before its round.

entries.note: The pick-up point's receipt, as Shouwu relays it on the line into Europe. The delivering carrier repeats it while the parcel waits, each a scan of its own.
A round that did not deliver; the delivering carrier's note can repeat it, and the wording is then read once.

entries.wording: Arrived at the origin international airport
Arrive at the delivery location Picked up by Shipping Partner
entries.note: The partner collecting the parcel in China after the order data and before its operation centre: the first scan in its hands, though it names a delivery location.

The flight leaving with the parcel, after China's export clearance.
On a line into the United States, two days after the destination's customs released the parcel: the last mile's first facility handling it, still on the way.
The delivering partner's first hub, a day after the destination's customs released the parcel: still on the way, not the acceptance.
The delivering partner's first hub sending the parcel on, after its arrival there.
The international flight leaving with the parcel, the departure matching its "International flight has arrived".

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle
Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon

entries.note: After the sort that follows customs at the destination.

entries.wording: Votre envoi est en cours de traitement sur le site de tri local.
entries.note: La Poste's sort at the local sorting site, which Shouwu gives after the country's code and before its Chinese label.

entries.wording: Votre envoi est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: La Poste's sort into the delivery round, as Colissimo's map reads it; relayed like the sort above.

entries.wording: Votre envoi a été distribué dans la boîte à lettres.

Delivered, naming no place; relayed like the sort above, two hours after the parcel went out for delivery.

entries.wording: Votre envoi na pas pu être distribué ce jour. Il sera remis en distribution au plus tôt. Nous vous prions daccepter nos excuses.
entries.note: La Poste's round put off with an apology and no reason: a delay, not an attempt at the door.

entries.wording: Votre envoi na pas pu être distribué ce jour. Un avis de passage a été déposé par le facteur dans votre boîte aux lettres.

entries.wording: Arrived at pick-up point. Package available for collection.

The Spanish last mile's failed round, between two rounds; its station keeping the parcel follows minutes later (Envío estacionado, Estacionado ubicado).
The waybill's electronic data received, at the second of the order's own data row.

entries.wording: The booking of the delivery is completed.

On the way to the airport of departure, after the departure from the sort facility in China.

entries.wording: Customs clearance completed, awaiting warehouse delivery
entries.note: Cleared at the destination, waiting to go on to the delivering partner's warehouse.

entries.wording: Loaded to movement / tour vehicle(return to sender)
entries.note: The last mile's vehicle taking the parcel back towards its sender: a return under way, not yet with the sender.
The flight booked at the airport, on a round hour, days before the take-off: a forecast like "Estimated time of take-off", so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The postal dispatch announced by the office of exchange, before the take-off.
The landing in the destination country.
The import cleared in the destination country, two days after the landing.
The destination post's office of exchange, after the import clearance: the way on, weeks after the warehouse accepted the parcel.
The destination post's office of exchange sending the parcel on to delivery.
The partner's receiving point in China, two days after the pick-up and minutes before the operation centre's departure.
The partner's hub in China, named by a two-letter code, after the operation centre's departure.
The flight's departure from China.
The landing abroad, before the destination's customs.

entries.wording: The customs clearance of the destination country has been completed
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs.
The destination's transfer centre, minutes after customs released the parcel.
The last mile's departure without a full stop, as its other lines can come.
The last mile's local facility without a full stop, the day before the round.
The last mile's round.
The destination post handing the parcel on after its office of exchange, at the minute of the next partner's terminal arrival.

entries.wording: The package has arrived at terminal (T1).
entries.note: The next partner's terminal, named by its number, at the minute of the hand-over.
The last mile's delivery to the letterbox; the line goes on with its delivery note and the carrier's contact details.

The last mile's delivery, as Shouwu relays it.
A hub in the destination country, days after customs released the parcel and before its departure from it.
The destination hub sending the parcel on, after its arrival there.

A delivering partner's warehouse, as the lines that relay the same partners read it: after its destination hub, before the delivery round. Shouwu words its own intake otherwise (Arrival processing center, Shipment arrived at facility).
